audit_items.proof_trace: Cap creation requires AdminCap via `mint_new_whitelist()` (whitelist.move:12), and permission grants require AdminCap via `update_permission()` (whitelist.move:53); permissions are stored centrally in `ProtocolApp` (not in the cap object), so transferring a cap does not transfer permissions. `ensure_has_permission()` checks both whitelist membership and the specific liquidation bit (2) at call time, so the assumption holds by construction.
